title_en: Opinions of the Supreme People's Procuratorate on the Application of the Charges of Crimes Prescribed in the Specific Provisions of the Criminal Law

articles.content_en:
Supreme People's Procuratorate
December 25, 1997
Opinions of the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Applying the Charges of Crimes Prescribed in the Specific Provisions of the Criminal Law
(Adopted by the 81st Session of the Eighth Procuratorial Committee of the Supreme People's Procuratorate on December 17, 1997)
Procuratorial Interpretation No. 3 [1997]
